game.title: Just Cause 3
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure in which Rico Rodriguez takes on a dictator on the Mediterranean islands of Medici, from Avalanche Studios (published by Square Enix), released 2015-11-30. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Rico comes home to Medici and takes on the regime. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Liberating Medici and Chaos
chapters.summary: Liberating settlements, provinces and whole islands, military bases, Chaos Objects and Chaos points.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Ancient Tombs, Rebel Shrines, tapes, vintage parts, Daredevil Jumps, the garages and 100 percent.

chapters.title: Challenges, Gears and Feats
chapters.summary: Earning Gears in Challenges, Feats, and beating other players' scores and Call-Outs.

chapters.title: Rebel Drops, Gear Mods and Encounters
chapters.summary: Rebel Drops, Gear MODs, Encounters, Heat-clearing and creative tether and explosive tricks.

chapters.title: Sky Fortress (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Sky Fortress story arc, its drones and its Challenges.

chapters.title: Mech Land Assault (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Mech Land Assault story arc, mechs, detention camps and its Challenges.

chapters.title: Bavarium Sea Heist (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Bavarium Sea Heist story arc, the Rocket Boat and the eDEN Spark.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Just Cause 3" (also missing as "Just Cause III"). justcause.fandom.com answers the API, with about 112 linked pages, including "Sky Fortress", "Mech Land Assault", "Bavarium Sea Heist" and "Downloadable content for Just Cause 3"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Mambo" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 225540. 8 of 66 Steam achievements are hidden; all sit in the main story chapter. The three expansion names appear in the achievement descriptions. "Like a Fish... in the Air!", "Look at the Sly Fox", "Break a Leg!" and "Stock-Keeping" sit inside the Sky Fortress block and "Free Birds" inside the Mech Land Assault block, so they were placed by schema position; the two eDEN Spark achievements sit in the Bavarium Sea Heist block. These need checking. The Steam list has some online parts (beating other players' Challenge scores and Call-Outs), kept with Challenges.
